chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The obligatory act of offering condolences is after the burial."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْوَاجِبَةُ: that which is obligatory or due

ai.seo_question: When is the obligatory time for offering condolences according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the obligatory condolence is given after the burial. It indicates the proper timing of ta'ziyah in relation to the rites of the deceased.
